```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r load packages and data}
library(tidyverse)
source("read_LI-600.R")

poplar_path1 = "../data/export_2024_10_21_164809/Bogar light/2024-10-18/Bogar light_LMB_2024_10_18_15_26_20_1.csv"
poplar_path2 = "../data/export_2024_10_21_164809/Bogar light/2024-10-18/Bogar light_LMB_2024_10_21_16_34_30_1.csv"
poplar_path3 = "../data/export_2024_10_21_164809/Bogar light/2024-10-18/Bogar light_LMB_2024_10_21_16_40_52_1.csv"
treatments = read_csv("240910_all_plants_and_treatments.csv")

```
```{r cleaning up data}
pop1 = read_li600_data(poplar_path1)
pop2 = read_li600_data(poplar_path2)
pop3 = read_li600_data(poplar_path3)

allpop = full_join(pop1, pop2)
allpop = full_join(allpop, pop3)

allpop$plantID = allpop$`Plant number`


treatments$plantID = str_pad(treatments$Plant, width = 3, pad = "0")
treatments$ABA = fct_recode(treatments$Tape_color, 
                            "3 wks" = "O", 
                            "2 wks" = "Y",
                            "0 wks" = "G", 
                            "None" = "B") %>%
  fct_relevel("0 wks", after = Inf)

treatments$soil = fct_recode(treatments$Soil, 
                            "Douglas fir - live" = "DE",
                            "Douglas fir - sterilized" = "DFS",
                            "Poplar - live" = "PE",
                            "Poplar - sterilized" = "PS")

allpop_with_tx = left_join(allpop, treatments)

allpop_with_tx$continuous_time = hms(allpop_with_tx$Time)

allpop_with_tx_noflag = subset(allpop_with_tx, is.na(remark))




pop_summ = allpop_with_tx_noflag %>% group_by(plantID, Species, soil, ABA) %>%
  summarize(mean_gsw = mean(as.numeric(gsw)), mean_PhiPS2 = mean(PhiPS2), num_obs = n())

```

Quick quality control: did gsw or PhiPS2 change consistently through time as we measured?

```{r Checking measurement drift, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(allpop_with_tx_noflag, aes(x = continuous_time, y = as.numeric(gsw))) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y~x)
```

Negative gsw are obviously wrong; leakage
around seal? Looks like a few bad values in the middle of the run.
```{r Get rid of erroneous gsw}
allpop_forgsw = subset(allpop_with_tx_noflag,
                       as.numeric(gsw) > 0)
```

```{r New gsw plot, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(allpop_forgsw, aes(x = continuous_time, y = as.numeric(gsw))) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y~x)
```
```{r Stats for gsw instrument drift}

drift_gsw = lm(as.numeric(gsw) ~ continuous_time, data = allpop_forgsw)
summary(drift_gsw) # Looks good.

```
GSW looks okay to me. How about PhiPS2?

```{r Checking PhiPS2, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(allpop_with_tx_noflag, aes(x = continuous_time, y = PhiPS2)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y~x)
```

Hmmm.... this DEFINITELY trends upward through time. I think this is what we would expect, since the sun is getting higher and the plants are continuing to ramp up their photosynthesis. I don't super trust the zero values, though. I suspect these are instances where a reading was accidentally taken but the instrument was not clamped to a leaf.

```{r}
allpop_forPhiPS2 = subset(allpop_with_tx_noflag, PhiPS2 > 0.01)
```

```{r}
ggplot(allpop_forPhiPS2, aes(x = continuous_time, y = PhiPS2)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y~x)
```
Okay, maybe these values are all okay? Definite upward trend. Can we correct for it?

```{r}
PhiPS2_model = lm(PhiPS2 ~ continuous_time, data = allpop_forPhiPS2)
summary(PhiPS2_model)
# Doesn't come out as significant, but the pattern jumps out to me either way

# PhiPS2_model_lmer = lmer(PhiPS2 ~ continuous_time + (1|ABA), data = allpop_forPhiPS2)
# summary(PhiPS2_model_lmer)
# Still not significant? Seems impossible, but what do I know?
```


```{r}
ggplot(allpop_forPhiPS2, aes(x = continuous_time, y = PhiPS2, color = ABA)) +
  geom_point()
```
